Segments are additionally shared with or cited in canonical commentaries, including both volumes of the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*, the *Buddhavaṃsa-aṭṭhakathā*, and the *Apadāna-aṭṭhakathā*, as well as the post-canonical *Nīti-gantha-saṅgaho Naradakkhadīpanī* [DharmaNexus].
